description: This file defines a React component named 'Library' that renders a user interface with tabs for navigating between playlists, recently added songs, and liked songs within a music application. It imports UI components from Material-UI and routing components from react-router-dom, and composes subcomponents for each library section.

methods.name: Library
methods.description: React functional component that displays a tabbed interface for navigating different sections of the music library.
